observations: Photo 0: yellow cooking gas cylinder with collar, handwritten markings, partial label, valve visible, on tiled floor.
Photo 1: blue cooking gas cylinder with GASDISC logo, top valve visible, on tiled floor.
Photo 2: blue cooking gas cylinder top view showing threaded valve outlet and collar, on tiled floor.
All photos carry a PETRONJAY BUSINESS watermark.

claims.evidence: No legible capacity stamp or scale reading in any photo; weight cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Capacity may not be 12.5kg; could be a smaller or larger cylinder.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the capacity marking stamped on the collar or neck ring, or the cylinder on a weighing scale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an empty cylinder of unverified capacity

risks.risk: Cylinder body may be rusted, dented, or past its hydrostatic test date.
risks.proof: Close-up photos or video of the body, foot ring, and collar stamps showing condition and test dates.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a cylinder requiring recertification or scrap

risks.risk: Valve may be damaged, leaking, or missing parts.
risks.proof: Photos of the valve from multiple angles showing threads, seal, and condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing or damaged valve

risks.risk: Cylinder may be empty rather than filled with gas.
risks.proof: Video or photo of the cylinder on a scale, or being shaken to show contents.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the capacity marking stamped on the cylinder collar or neck ring.
Close-up photos of the cylinder body, foot ring, and valve from multiple angles.
Photo or video of the cylinder on a weighing scale.
response.reason: The photos identify the item as a cooking gas cylinder, but capacity, condition, and fill status cannot be verified remotely, so it is priced at its worst case as an empty, unverified cylinder.
